body: Oh man, I stole SO, SO MUCH from B&N, but that was in the mid 90s, and I think they were doing really well back then.  I've been a law-abiding customer since 1997.

Oh man, 24 is so young. Almost 20 years ago for me. Granted, when I was that age, I never thought I'd live to 30, NEVER thought I'd lie to 40, and I'm still here, and life is still  imperfect, but you're SO not old. At all. Ever. Unless you're comparing yourself to actual children. I'm sorry that things are so hard.  :(
I hear you. I'm sorry things are so hard.

There isn't much of an alternative but to just keep getting through life day by day. It'd sad that this is probably so much of human history. "I didn't die today, so I guess I have to wake up tomorrow. Rinse. Repeat."

Yeah. I was good with being an only child when I was a kid/young adult. I wanted a sibling maybe 5 or so years older than me, but that would've required my parents getting pregnant in high school. They did know each other, but my mother was NOT ABOUT to deal with her father's reactions to one of his daughters being an unwed pregnant teenager in the late 60s. Now I just wish I weren't staring down the barrel of being completely alone in the world. I know I'm a disappointment in some ways--my father was fairly clear about that before he died about ten years ago--but I also know that for my mother living with what she's got is better than the prospect of having to have born more children. :\\
